current_truth.current_ecad: H2-R2.1.5 is reviewed. Two native R2 KiCad projects contain 1208 schematic instances, 4305 physical pins and 788 canonical nets; both pass ERC with zero errors and zero warnings under the current passive-pin library, which does not prove rail-driver completeness or exclude output conflicts. Six domains, 173 controller pins, 34 cross-project nets and 227 cross-sheet nets reconcile. M1-35 carries latched FAULT_KILL to the independent front indicator, leaving nine true NC reserves. H3-R2.0.1 hash-binds fourteen exact inputs and assigns all 22 native sheets exactly once across seven verification workstreams. H6-NATIVE-ELECTRICAL-SEMANTICS remains a separate required production-release review. H6 placement and routing are in progress on the current 80 x 150-mm boards; production release has not begun, and the archived R1 ECAD is historical and must not be built
current_truth.virtual_electrical: The original H3-R2.7 review is retained for its recorded inputs. Current H3 diagnostics and source hashes are regenerated after the user-approved four-port USB4105-GF-A unification: 250 exact R2 component groups and 1208 schematic instances retain provenance and an H3 owner, with nine methods and twelve pass/fail rules. This inventory/freshness check is not current electrical qualification: the H3-R2 acceptance package's current_power_scope and existing H6 power, startup and interface findings remain authoritative. The 51 physical-only rows remain open under H5/H6/H8 and the F5/F6 i8080 implementation obligation remains explicit. USB connector ratings do not raise the product input limits; routed re-analysis and first-power-on evidence remain required. Neither regenerated diagnostics nor historical R1 evidence authorizes an order
current_truth.executable_firmware: F2-R2.5 is in progress for six production-SDK targets; the first-spin diagnostic, current R2 BSP import and recovery bundle are not reviewed
current_truth.instruction_emulation: F3-R2 and F-PO remain blocked; historical S3 QEMU evidence cannot prove the current R2 peripherals, PCB or non-S3 execution
current_truth.joined_release: The original global H4-R2 review retains its recorded 24 joined inputs, 173/173 controller rows, 80/80 M1 contacts and 12 qualified target configurations; source refresh does not relabel that build evidence as current. H5-R2.1 revalidates all 248 current purchasable groups / 1216 articles with zero unmapped route after four USB-C receptacles are consolidated into one GCT group. The GCT minimum-9 stock-backed pre-order is explicit, and WBC16-1TLC remains an order-time sourcing gate. Current HW/FW source reconciliation is separate from target build, electrical and assembly qualification. H6 routed release candidate and immutable P8 order release have not run
